title: Outside a project the brewed devbin refuses help and -h with exit 5, and its refusal names the keg's long path and an upgrade --from a project does not need
body:
Outside a project, the brewed devbin answers only --version, version, shell-init, install and use. A bare `devbin`, `--help`, `-h`, `help`, `help --why`, `help install`, `devbin devbin`, `doctor` and a typo all exit 5 with "this is a devbin INSTALL, not a project -- it cannot be run from". So a new user cannot read `help install` before seeding a project. usage-rules.md:57 says an explicit `-h` exits 0. The refusal's remedies also name the keg's long path, and an upgrade `--from` that a project does not need.

dc's from-brew walk of 0.1.15 (2026-10-27) ran each step as a plain brew user under `env -i`, with a scratch HOME (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/walk015/run-20261027-0916Z/: findings.md, and steps/<id>.{out,err,rc}). vc measured each finding against that record and main at 15f2a973.

## Measured

- Steps 009 and 012 to 021: each command above exits 5 with the refusal at bin/devbin:263-279, which lets only install, shell-init and use through (bin/devbin:263-265).
- The seed remedy (bin/devbin:273) prints `<the keg>/libexec/bin/devbin install --into <your project>`, where `devbin install --into` from PATH works (steps 027, 029).
- The upgrade remedy (`vendor_from_hint`) adds `--from <the keg>`, which `bin/devbin upgrade` does not need when the machine names its install.

## Fix

- From an install tree, `-h`, `--help`, `help` and `help <page>` print devbin's own help and pages and exit 0, under a line saying this is a machine install and how to seed a project.
- Every other command keeps its exit 5 refusal.
- The refusal's remedies name the commands as a user types them: `devbin install --into <your project>` when the devbin on PATH is this install, and `cd <your project> && bin/devbin upgrade` when the machine names this install.

## Done when

1. From the brew keg outside a project, `devbin -h`, `devbin --help`, `devbin help` and `devbin help install` print help and exit 0, each held by an arm.
2. Any other command from an install still exits 5.
3. With the devbin on PATH resolving to the install, and the machine naming it, the refusal's remedies read `devbin install --into <your project>` and `cd <your project> && bin/devbin upgrade`.
4. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

0251 is fixed by cdd2f186 (tree 42b05d7c), the first of the line's four commits on 6bb2e15c (0251, then 0253 8e39dc89, then 0262 b0ea3fe0, then 0266 f172b06f). 6bb2e15c is the PRE: the version chain's tip 1792ae25 with main's 0257 (landed on main as f3cbab33) picked, and it is not landed again. The chain under the line has since landed on main (0259 1229314e, 0260 e6fd4a98, 0263 4a9bd32e, 0264 ce5d39e1, 0265 7c814e93), and main's code outside intent/ equals 6bb2e15c. l7 was built because 0253 was amended (0253's Resolution says why). cdd2f186 has the same stable git patch-id as its predecessor in l6, 75722e6d, and the same tree. The bundle's tip is the tip the landing run tested, f172b06f.

### What changed, against "Done when"

1. **[x] From the brew keg outside a project, `devbin -h`, `devbin --help`, `devbin help` and `devbin help install` print help and exit 0, each held by an arm.**
   - bin/devbin: in the install-tree branch, a bare `devbin`, `-h`, `--help` and `help` go to install_help before the exempt-set check, and exit with its status.
   - lib/help: install_help reads no project config. It prints the tree line with "-- a machine install, not a project.", the line "In a project, bin/devbin help lists what that project offers. To seed one:" and the seed line (seed_hint). With no topic it lists every command devbin ships, grouped by `_print_grouped`, the one listing shape print_help now asks too, and ends with "Run: <launcher> help <command>   for its page." With a topic it prints devbin's page, found by `_help_walk` over lib/pages as help_file finds devbin's.
   - A topic devbin ships no page for, and a flag help does not take (eg `help --env x`), exit 2 with one stderr line and no header.
   - The arms: "from Homebrew's keg outside a project, a bare devbin, -h, --help, help and help --why list what devbin ships, and exit 0 (0251, 0266)" and "from Homebrew's keg, help install prints devbin's page for install under the install's line, and a page devbin does not ship, or a flag help does not take, exits 2 (0251, 0266)". The second reads the page from where the runtime is (`libexec/bin/.devbin/lib/pages/install.md`), and fails if it cannot read it or it is empty, before asserting it.
2. **[x] Any other command from an install still exits 5.**
   - bin/devbin's exempt set is install, shell-init and use, as before, plus `devbin` in its help forms alone (`devbin devbin`, `devbin devbin help`, `-h`, `--help`). Its other forms, eg `devbin devbin templates`, are refused like any other verb.
   - The arm "from Homebrew's keg, any other command, a typo included, still exits 5 with the install refusal (0251)" runs doctor, frobnicate, `check all` and `devbin templates`.
3. **[x] With the devbin on PATH resolving to the install, and the machine naming it, the refusal's remedies read `devbin install --into <your project>` and `cd <your project> && bin/devbin upgrade`.**
   - lib/helpers: install_remedies is the one SEED/UPGRADE block, which the refusal and the install overview both print. seed_hint names the launcher through launcher_shown (0252), which is `devbin` when the devbin on PATH is this install.
   - vendor_from_hint prints the plain upgrade line when machine_names_install says the machine's install (machine_install_root) is this install, compared physically as install_named_root names it; a relative DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX counts for nothing. Otherwise it keeps `--from <install>`.
   - The arm "with the devbin on PATH being Homebrew's keg and the machine naming it, the refusal's remedies read devbin install --into and cd <your project> && bin/devbin upgrade (0251)" asserts both lines exactly and refutes `upgrade --from`. It then runs the printed upgrade line in a project seeded from the keg, and checks the project records the install as its source.
4. **[x] The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU with the tree scans and help.** CI on the pushed head is vc's landing to read.

- lib/cmd/devbin: `devbin devbin` from an install prints show_install_overview: what the tree is, the install on a line of its own, the remedies block, and the reference config by lib_rel's path. The arm "devbin devbin from Homebrew's keg says what an install is, and how to seed and upgrade a project from it, at exit 0 (0251, 0266)" checks that the reference config it names is there.
- lib/pages/install.md and lib/pages/shell-init.md now say what an install answers.

### The critic review

- The critic-shell subagent reviewed the bank, 2c932599 and faa4d35a on 0252's bank 8dcd6402: 2 critical, 3 warning, 7 recommendations and 4 style. The settlement (27df1847, with 376c915a before it) settled every finding except R7, which was filed as 0262. vc approved the settled unit. The line carries it as the one commit cdd2f186.
  - **CRITICAL (red-control, the `help install` arm):** the page was read from a path no keg has, so the assertion matched anything. The arm now reads the page under `libexec/bin/.devbin/lib/`, and fails if it cannot read it or it is empty.
  - **CRITICAL (Highlander, the overview's reference config):** the overview named a reference config that is not there, and an arm asserted it. It now prints `<install>/<lib_rel>/config.reference.yaml`, and the arm checks the file exists.
  - **WARNING (the remedies spelled three times):** taken, as seed_hint and install_remedies in lib/helpers, asked by the refusal, the overview and install_help.
  - **WARNING (`devbin devbin templates` answered from an install):** taken. The exemption is narrowed to devbin's help forms, and the exit-5 arm runs `devbin templates`.
  - **WARNING (lib/pages/shell-init.md untrue):** taken. The page names `use` and the install's own help among what the fallback's devbin answers.
  - **Recommendations taken:**
    - R1: the plain upgrade line is run in a project, not only string-tested;
    - R2: vendor_from_hint's comment limits the plain line to a project whose manifest records the kind of its source, and says a project recording none is told to name one with `--from`;
    - R3: machine_names_install, beside machine_install_root, is the predicate vendor_from_hint asks;
    - R4: a relative DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX keeps `--from`;
    - R5: `_print_command_row` is the one row, for a project's listing and an install's;
    - R6: install_help captures builtin_commands and the group table with their status.
  - **Style taken:** S1 to S3's comments now say what the code does, and S4: an unknown help flag is refused at exit 2 ("unknown help option").
  - **Not taken here:** R7, the inline `manifest_field ... kind` comparison at each reader, was filed as 0262, which is the line's third commit and moves 0251's overview onto is_install_tree.
- **The critic leg** ran `intent critic shell` on the line's changed shell (12 files, lib/help and lib/cmd/devbin among them) and exited 0. It asked 2 of the 6 shell rules.

### Which arms are red on main, and which hold unchanged behaviour

- **Red on 6bb2e15c, for the issue's reason:**
  - "from Homebrew's keg outside a project, a bare devbin, -h, --help, help and help --why list what devbin ships, and exit 0 (0251, 0266)", "from Homebrew's keg, help install prints devbin's page ... (0251, 0266)" and "devbin devbin from Homebrew's keg says what an install is ... (0251, 0266)": each exits 5 with the install refusal, so `assert_success` fails.
  - "with the devbin on PATH being Homebrew's keg and the machine naming it, the refusal's remedies read ... (0251)": the base prints the plain seed line (0252) but `upgrade --from <opt>`, so the plain-line check fails.
- **Holds unchanged behaviour, green on the base and at the tip:** "from Homebrew's keg, any other command, a typo included, still exits 5 with the install refusal (0251)". It cannot be red on the base, which refused every one.
- **Changed by 0251:**
  - machinepointer.bats' 0195 arm, "run in Homebrew's install, the refusal's seed and upgrade lines name the opt link ... (0195, 0251, 0252, 0266)", reaches the refusal with doctor where it asked help, with DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX naming another directory so the machine does not name this install. It holds the `--from` side, which the base printed too. It is red on the base at 0266's seed line, which 0266's Resolution records.
  - localinstall.bats' "an install still refuses PROJECT questions" asks a project command where it asked `devbin help`. The critic measured it green on both sides on the bank; the light ran localinstall.bats whole at the tip.

### Evidence

- **Red on 6bb2e15c:** red clone l7/red-6bb2e15c at 08435b43 (6bb2e15c plus the line's seven test files from the tip: contract, dispatch, formula, helpers, localinstall, machinepointer, shellinit; neutral no longer differs from the base), BSD. machinepointer.bats ran 1 ok and 9 not ok, logged at 17:07:03Z by the driver's date -u; the four 0251 arms above are among the not ok, and the exit-5 guard is the one ok.
- **Arm greens** at f172b06f: machinepointer BSD at 17:07:44Z and GNU at 17:08:29Z, 10 of 10 each.
- **The light** at f172b06f, in slot 01M61QKQNRN8Y972DZCVTG0MNY. START was 17:06:29Z and the driver exited 0 at 17:51:42Z on 2026-10-28, both by date -u. The slot ran the line's arms first, then one light. It did not run the version chain's arms again, since the chain has landed on main.
  - Run whole under BSD and GNU, every test passing:
    - version (73), releasecut (140) and doctor (65);
    - helpers (115), dispatch (121), machinepointer (35), formula (34), use (30), shellinit (38), localinstall (62), contract (43), fleet (155) and install (103, its one case-folding skip);
    - help (58).
  - documentation (28) under BSD, and under GNU with the tree scans.
  - The tree scans ran under GNU, and every test passed: neutral (10), documentation (28), readonlygit (11), harness (34, its two expected skips), vendoredmd (3), workroom (5) and installhints (1). helpers and contract ran whole under both.
  - The critic leg exited 0, as above.
  - The log is ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/r23c/run-l7-01M61QKQNRN8Y972DZCVTG0MNY.log, and the TAP is in l7/runs/ (arms/ and light/).
- **The bundle:** see SHA256SUMS in this directory (`line.bundle`, ref l7 at f172b06f, on 1792ae25).
- **The landing:** vc landed it at 01ed37e6 with land-stack.sh (LAND_BASE_OFF_MAIN=1), commit by commit, as run. Its paths equal the tested tip's. The BSD and GNU full suites run once before the cut, and CI reads the pushed head.

- **CI:** run 40752126678 on the pushed head a6a875b3, which carries the landing, read green by vc.
